notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.notes:
I’m excited to share some great news: the demo for ROVE – The Wanderer’s Tale is officially live on Steam!

The demo contains the first chapter of ROVE where the Wanderer wakes up in a coffin not knowing who and where he is. Guided by a mysterious voice, hack-and-slash your way through the enemies, meet two quirky NPCs and finally escape from the crypt.

I’d love to hear your thoughts, if you have any feedback feel free to share it on Steam or on Discord. Any kind of feedback is appreciated.
